WITH sma_10002_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) AS metric_time__month
    , CASE WHEN case when valid_order_cnt >= 1 then member_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , valid_order_cnt AS __monthly_paid_order_count
    , net_cents_sum AS __monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , CASE WHEN case when valid_order_cnt >= 2 then member_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."account_month_paid" account_month_paid_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_17.monthly_paid_repeat_rate) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
  , MAX(subq_17.monthly_paid_avg_order_value) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(__monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10002_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    case when monthly_paid_buyer_count = 0 then null else monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count / monthly_paid_buyer_count end AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
    , case when monthly_paid_order_count = 0 then null else monthly_paid_sales_cents / monthly_paid_order_count end AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
  FROM (
    SELECT
      SUM(__monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
      , SUM(__monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
      , SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
      , SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
    FROM sma_10002_cte
    WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
  ) subq_16
) subq_17
